question.knowledge_point: Finding the Magnitude of a Vector-Valued Function
question.worked_solution:
Evaluating the function at $t=3,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r(3) & =⟨3(3)-1,\,2(3)⟩ \\  & =⟨8,\,6⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the magnitude of this vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|r(3)| & =\sqrt{{(8)}^{2}+{(6)}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{64+36} \\  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$
